name: And.intro
content:
The theorem `And.intro` takes a proof of `P`, a proof of `Q`, and gives a proof of `P ∧ Q` where `P Q : Prop`.

Given,
```
hP : P
hQ : Q
```
we have `And.intro hP hQ : P ∧ Q`

## Alternative Notation
Typed as `\<hP,hQ\>`,
```
⟨hP,hQ⟩ : P ∧ Q
```
instead of
```
And.intro hP hQ : P ∧ Q
```
